answer: Counterparty diversity is a basalt breakwater against the sybil gale: rewards need trade with 20 distinct, unrelated counterparties per epoch, on the public graph. An identity trading only inside its clique earns nothing, however many clones it makes. Each payment's voyage is checked: 1,000 fakes must post 25 POA each, 25,000 POA locked, for 500 POA of rewards, a 24,500 POA loss. An honest agent pays one 25 POA bond once, keeps its full share.
